message.content:
Acme Corporation got double-billed - they were charged twice for the same Pro plan annual invoice and reached out asking us to make it right. Please refund the duplicate: it's the $90.00 charge from yesterday on their account. Process it as a duplicate refund.

Just that one charge - don't touch anyone else's payments while you're in there.

You can reach our Stripe account at `$STRIPE_URL` (test mode). Authenticate with the secret key `sk_tes…stic` as a Bearer token, e.g. `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_tes…stic" "$STRIPE_URL/v1/customers"`. It speaks the standard Stripe REST API (form-encoded bodies), so the usual `/v1/customers`, `/v1/charges`, and `/v1/refunds` endpoints all work.
